failedAssertions.reason: `up` now takes the preflight port-conflict path (tier was skipped and did not enter health-check timeout), but owner resolution reported `PID 0 (<unknown>)` instead of the actual owning PID/process.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: First-time flow cannot complete because `mlx-stack pull` is still unimplemented (all pull attempts return `Not yet implemented. Coming in the pull-command feature.`). As a result no models are downloaded, `up` skips all tiers and LiteLLM, and `http://localhost:4000/v1/models` is unreachable.

Config propagation is partially verified (`litellm-port` persisted to config/init and up summary uses port 5000; `memory-budget-pct 60` is reflected in recommend/init budget; `model-dir` is reflected by `models`). Full assertion remains blocked because `pull` is unimplemented, so default-quant/model-dir pull behavior cannot be validated and `up` skips model servers/LiteLLM due missing local models.

Cross-command consistency is only partially testable in this build: profile->recommend->init linkage, schema_version rejection, and vllm_flags->dry-run flag translation are validated, but required benchmark/models artifact consistency cannot be completed because `bench --save` and `pull` are both unimplemented placeholders.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented lifecycle rerun friction where macOS permissions can cause port-owner lookup to return PID 0 (<unknown>) via psutil.net_connections AccessDenied.

frictions.description: On this macOS host, psutil.net_connections(kind="inet") raised AccessDenied, so conflict owner lookup can appear as PID 0 (<unknown>) during port-conflict detection checks.
frictions.resolution: Captured diagnostics and retained VAL-UP-012 as failed until owner PID/process can be resolved reliably.

frictions.description: Lifecycle cross-flow assertions remain gated by unimplemented pull/bench surfaces.
frictions.resolution: Confirmed placeholders across multiple targets and config states; kept affected assertions blocked for tooling milestone.

dedupedBlockers: mlx-stack pull is not yet implemented in this build, blocking first-time journey and pull-dependent cross-flow checks.
